content.query:
select CODE CODE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CODE CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES WHERE CODE='215' AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE'
UNION ALL
SELECT CODE CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES WHERE CODE='201' AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE'
UNION ALL
SELECT CODE CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES WHERE CODE='314' AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE'
UNION ALL
SELECT CODE CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_PRODUCTCODES WHERE CODE='999999' AND DATA_MART_FIELD='PROD_TYPE' ) temp order by CODE, SCD_START_DATE
